description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) GENE-WROUGHT MIGHT (Assault Brethren, 1 CP) — WP-M3b (SMCodexB.gd, through the custom:sm11e dispatcher). Fixture sm11e_m3b_active (P1 Space Marines ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3b_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges as in every WP-M3b scenario plus the assault doctrine active for P1's army (doctrine state; the selection UI is WP-M2a's). The fight list's real click selects the Heavy Intercessor Squad (engaged with the Nobz); unit_selected_to_fight opens; a real click on 'Use on Heavy Intercessor Squad' spends 1 CP; its melee attacks have [LANCE] (effect_grant_lance) and — with the assault doctrine — +1 AP (the attack aggregator returns ap 1 for melee, 0 for ranged).
